def prepare():
    import hashlib, importlib, importlib.util, sys
    from pathlib import Path
    package='glm_reconstruction_v52_helpers'
    root=Path('/home/matteius/experiments/glm-reconstruction-20261006/build-native-fused-v52/glm_reconstruction_v52_helpers')
    if package not in sys.modules:
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(package,root/'__init__.py',submodule_search_locations=[str(root)])
        module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[package]=module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    if Path(sys.modules[package].__file__).resolve() != (root/'__init__.py').resolve():
        raise ValueError('fused helper package belongs to another build')
    for name, expected in {'glm_fused_moe.py': '5ad5f2c9b80fa6db16b228a99b899de97e4a9989e0c209937e041e0480ece11e', 'reconstruction_probe.py': '64b40634adcf237ce2f043e68317dca66090bfcba1a4a5a0ac08d1aa0ef104db', 'fused_moe_probe.py': '495ae529b473cdfba04a4b4dd0796f8011b8b32aeb6580ac82a0b11ec71fe760', 'fused_weight_layout.py': 'b83deadceebde22722c6eece537580a0fc1b5c2c414abb3272cd43a32fb6b8b3', 'expert_reconstruction.py': '6e7adc0dddebf03fb28f67a64ba0577fcedaac23feb2fb075a327672fb7f8d3a', 'glm_int4.py': 'be71985a4fd66c3f99d950abb5da4f8383ad607c421c8b3bfbe1ec3564e0a843', '__init__.py': '6c6ec57de9f82ef42d82760f144a4571cb16b3cd6de33aaa7aa9fd65e8ab1fa1', 'reconstruction_native.py': 'ea128543c4cfeaf3ca7c8b040152446abb4cef1bc4d99dbd50b6952d4eb751a9'}.items():
        if hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=expected:
            raise ValueError('fused helper changed: '+name)
    from glm_reconstruction_v52_helpers.glm_fused_moe import NativeFusedMoE
    build=Path('/home/matteius/experiments/glm-reconstruction-20261006/build-native-fused-v52')
    resources={'fused_int4a'+str(bits): NativeFusedMoE(build,namespace='glm_reconstruction_v52',activation_bits=bits,
                                                     prepared_weight_layout=True)
               for bits in (8,4)}
    if True:
        import torch
        from glm_reconstruction_v52_helpers.fused_weight_layout import PreparedWeightLayout
        report=Path('/home/matteius/experiments/glm-reconstruction-20261006/build-native-fused-v52')/('weight-layout-rank'+str(torch.distributed.get_rank())+'.json')
        resources['_weight_layout']=PreparedWeightLayout(torch.npu.synchronize,torch.distributed.get_world_size(),
                                                         report_path=report)
    return resources

def validate(resources):
    from glm_reconstruction_v52_helpers.fused_moe_probe import gate_case
    records=[gate_case(resources['fused_int4a'+str(activation)],bits,tokens=tokens)
             for activation in (8,4) for bits in (2,3,4) for tokens in (2, 17)]
    return {'passed':True,'cases':len(records),'native_fused_stages':2,
             'input_quantization_passes_per_token':1,
             'fp16_intermediate_gm_bytes':0,'model_quality':'not_evaluated'}
